    "text": "In the theory of probability, we are interested in experiments that involve an element of chance. An experiment is any process of observation or measurement. A random experiment is an experiment where the outcome cannot be predicted with certainty.",

    "text": "**Definition 1.1** (Union of Events) The union of two events $A$ and $B$, denoted by $A \\cup B$, is the event containing all outcomes that are in $A$ or in $B$ or in both. That is,\n$$A \\cup B = \\{x | x \\in A \\text{ or } x \\in B\\}$$",
